firstRun.en: Run a local source-only first pass, then review the problem, evidence boundary, proposed change, likely side effects and separate security and product retests.
firstRun.zh-CN: 先执行一次只读本地源码的检查，再逐项审查问题、证据边界、修改建议、可能副作用，以及分开的安全复测和产品功能复测。
firstRun.ja: ローカルソースだけを対象に最初の確認を実行し、問題、証拠の限界、修正案、副作用、セキュリティと通常機能の再テストを分けて確認する。

audience.en: Web product owners and builders who use AI coding agents and need a reviewable security-hardening workflow without offensive-security expertise.
audience.zh-CN: 使用 AI coding agent、需要可审查 Web 安全加固流程，但不具备攻防专业背景的 Web 产品所有者与开发者。

positioning.en: An agent skill and deterministic evidence toolkit for scoping, auditing, proposing minimal hardening patches, and retesting web projects.
positioning.zh-CN: 一套用于范围确认、风险检查、最小加固补丁和复测的 agent skill 与确定性证据工具。

en: Built-in source depth targets JavaScript/TypeScript and Python and is not a universal SAST engine or vulnerability scanner.
Agent-guided reviews require project context and human review; installing the Skill does not prove a project secure.
The animated result is one suspected source lead in a repository-owned local fixture and does not establish third-party coverage or exploitability.
The ordinary project journeys are fixed-commit source reviews; no hosted instance was probed and no upstream validation is claimed.
zh-CN: 内置源码深度集中在 JavaScript/TypeScript 与 Python，不是通用 SAST 引擎或全覆盖漏洞扫描器。
agent-guided 审查需要项目上下文和人工复核；安装 Skill 不代表项目已经安全。
动画结果只是仓库自有本地 fixture 中的一条 suspected 源码线索，不证明第三方覆盖率或可利用性。
普通项目旅程是固定 commit 的源码审查；未探测托管实例，也不声称得到上游验证。
